decision.summary: A multi-axis offset initiates around index 438: N and U rise sharply and remain elevated through 459; E drops slightly later (~440) and also remains low. The return phase is unobserved within the allowed context (ends at 480), and no opposing motion is evident in any axis before 480. Hence, the interval is classified as uncertain—consistent with a temporary offset but not confirmed due to missing recovery.

intervals.observation: N and U show a sharp multi-sample upward shift starting at index 438 (N) and 439 (U), sustained through ~459; E shows a delayed downward offset beginning near 440, persisting without clear return by 459. Interior levels remain elevated relative to pre-438 baseline on N/U, while E stays depressed. No opposing return observed within allowed context [400,480].
